title: Push and publish
question: Main has many local commits that aren't pushed, and the Pages deploy handoff isn't finished, so the current build can't be played from another machine. What should happen?

options.label: Push main now
options.note: Secret-scan, then push main to GitHub. Pages stays as it is until the deploy handoff is done.

options.label: Push and finish the Pages deploy
options.note: Push main, then finish the Pages switch (assets from R2) so the game is playable online from the pushed build. Deploy checks run first.

options.label: Not yet
options.note: Keep working locally. Ask again later.

decision: Push now, and push regularly from now on.
